topic: vitest junit false green differs from node's
lesson: For a vitest leaf, a matching testcase NAME in the junit report does NOT prove it ran: vitest LISTS every test in the file and marks the ones its -t filter missed as <skipped/>. Proven by control: -t 'a name that does not exist' still emitted all three testcases with their real names, each skipped. The discriminator is present AND NOT <skipped/> AND NOT <failure/>. This is a different mechanism from tools/junit-run.mjs, where a non-matching --name yields ONE testcase named after the FILE PATH - so a checker written for one runner is wrong for the other.
source: ask-period-continuation leaf verification: the first pass checked name-match only and reported all six green; the vitest control showed name-match alone also passes for a filter that matched nothing
